sources.title: Lyssa Royal Holt — official biography
sources.publisher: Lyssa Royal Holt / Seed of Life Institute
sources.notes: States professional work since 1985 and a psychological approach to training. Documents a self-description, not external verification of ET communication.

sources.title: Free Video Library
sources.publisher: Lyssa Royal Holt / Seed of Life Institute
sources.accessMethod: Direct catalogue text and outbound YouTube metadata; videos not watched
sources.notes: Dates Sasha association to 1988; describes Quantum Map as a metaphor. Lists recordings from November 2010 and June 2011. Official channel link resolves to UCeuLbnOjJBUfqqm2KEqkpLA.

sources.title: About Wendy
sources.notes: Gives 1995 as channeling start; describes transition from automatic writing and angelic guides to verbal Pleiadian channeling.

sources.title: Clearing & Purification — 2025 course page
sources.notes: Biography instead gives 1994, conflicting with the official About page. Describes the Pleiadian collective as roughly 2,500 formless beings and markets Language of Light / Galactic Light Codes. Claims of benefits are promotional, not clinical evidence.

sources.title: About — The E.T. Whisperer
sources.notes: Identifies Treb, Aridif, Metatron and their claimed classifications. Has no exact channeling start date; footer copyright is not a founding date.

sources.title: How Daniel Scranton Woke Up & Started Channeling
sources.notes: States verbal channeling since 2010 and daily website messages since 2012; links his public YouTube channel. Enumerates several purported entities.

sources.title: Daniel Scranton's Channeling — recent transmissions
sources.accessMethod: Direct page text; embedded videos not watched
sources.notes: Current text attributes messages to a nonphysical Arcturian collective, Ashanti of Sassani and other sources. Lists paid readings, classes, activations, light-language and sound offerings.

sources.title: Brad Johnson — Adronis from Sirius Shares His Messages with Humanity
sources.accessMethod: Direct programme text; interview audio not listened to
sources.notes: Interview programme biography supplies retrospective onset and changing density claims; audio not reviewed.

sources.title: The Prime Mentor: Brad Johnson — YouTube
sources.accessMethod: Indexed channel description only; videos not watched
sources.notes: Public description identifies Johnson as a spiritual mentor, communicator of Adronis, intuitive healer and author. Modern website theprimementor.com returned no readable body text.

sources.title: About Ishuwa, the Yahyel, and Shaun
sources.notes: Dates Swanson's healing-facilitation and channeling practice to 1995. This is not explicitly the first Ishuwa session. Presents Yahyel as humanlike ETs in multiple Milky Way locations.

sources.title: Ishuwa and the Yahyel — Opening Contact with Our Galactic Family
sources.accessMethod: Direct page text and outbound embedded-video URL; videos not watched
sources.notes: Makes a claim linking Yahyel to the Phoenix Lights, and a qualified future-contact claim. Neither is independent confirmation of an ET explanation.

sources.title: Welcome to the original Kryon website
sources.notes: States 1989 start and calls Kryon an angelic entity. Explicitly says Carroll is not affiliated with other people or groups using the Kryon name. Describes free channelings and commercial products including a healing programme.

sources.title: A New Beginning in Phoenix!
sources.notes: Esther retrospectively says she and Jerry first met Abraham in Phoenix in 1985. This dates reported personal experience, not the age of the claimed consciousness.

sources.title: About Abraham-Hicks
sources.notes: Describes Abraham as a nonphysical group consciousness and summarizes manifestation teachings. The site says Jerry and Esther did not favor the word channeling.

sources.title: Esther Hicks Official Biography
sources.notes: States Abraham-Hicks workshops since 1987 and publication of Ask and It Is Given in 2004. Page dates are displayed revision metadata, not the beginning of the practice.

sources.title: About Paul Selig
sources.notes: Dates a reported clairvoyant awakening to 1987 and describes subsequent energy-healing work and a 'medium for the living' practice. Lists channeled books and links public YouTube.

sources.title: Who Is Sanaya?
sources.notes: Retrospective self-report distinguishes the 2009 poems from Sanaya’s 2010 naming.

sources.title: Readings — Suzanne Giesemann
sources.notes: Frames readings as communication with deceased loved ones and guides, distinct from ET species channeling. Her use of 'evidence-based' is a practitioner description, not independent validation of survival after death.

profiles.name: Germane & Sasha / Lyssa Royal Holt
profiles.classification: Claimed multidimensional collective and Pleiadian consciousness
profiles.origin: Sasha is described as Pleiadian; Germane as a multidimensional group consciousness, not a verified biological species.
profiles.dateBasis: Official biography gives 1985. Sasha is separately dated to 1988 in the video catalogue.
profiles.summary: A long-running channeling teacher whose archive combines ET contact narratives with self-examination, meditation and a galactic-origin cosmology.
claims: Presents messages attributed to Germane and Sasha.
Uses Galactic Heritage Cards to organize a cosmological narrative.
caveats: 1985 is the professional-work date, not an independently observed ET contact.
Historical 'galactic' events are claims within her material.
A legacy biography indexed elsewhere gives 1986; the current official biography gives 1985.

profiles.name: The 9th Dimensional Pleiadian Collective / Wendy Kennedy
profiles.origin: Presented as a Pleiadian-associated group of roughly 2,500 nonphysical beings; '9th dimensional' is the tradition's term.
profiles.dateBasis: Official About page says 1995; an official 2025 course biography says 1994. Do not collapse this conflict into a precise onset.
profiles.summary: A channeling and spiritual-teaching practice linking spoken messages, Language of Light and written Galactic Light Codes.
claims: Reports an initial automatic-writing phase with angelic guides before verbal Pleiadian messages.
Markets codes and sounds as tools for spiritual alignment.
caveats: The start year differs across official pages.
Healing and cellular-resonance language is not evidence of a measured medical effect.
This collective should not automatically be equated with every other channeler's 'Pleiadians'.

profiles.name: Treb, Aridif & Metatron / Rob Gauthier
profiles.classification: Claimed reptilian-human hybrid, ancient Pleiadian, and archangel
profiles.origin: Official lore calls Treb a fifth-density Capella hybrid and Aridif an ancient Pleiadian from Deneb. These are spiritual labels, not established astronomical populations.
profiles.dateBasis: Current official biography says more than a decade; no securely dated first session was established in this source set.
profiles.summary: The E.T. Whisperer is a public trance-channeling practice presenting multiple distinct guides and teaching self-empowerment.
claims: Reports messages from Treb, Aridif and the archangel Metatron.
Official descriptions assign separate origins and developmental levels to the guides.
caveats: Do not use the website's 2025 copyright as a founding date.
Deneb and the Pleiades are distinct astronomical references; the source's 'ancient Pleiadian from Deneb' wording is retained as lore.
Commercial services and first-person claims do not verify entities.

profiles.name: The 9D Arcturian Council / Daniel Scranton
profiles.entity: The 9D Arcturian Council; other guides and collectives
profiles.classification: Claimed nonphysical star-associated collective; mixed spiritual entities
profiles.origin: The Council is associated with Arcturus. Other messages are attributed to archangels, spiritual teachers and named ETs.
profiles.dateBasis: Official biography dates verbal practice to 2010 and daily website messages to 2012. It does not separately date the first Arcturian Council message.
profiles.summary: A prolific text and video archive with daily purported transmissions, courses and one-to-one sessions.
claims: Attributes messages to the Arcturian Council and many other identities.
Recent material also presents Ashanti as Sassani and The Creators as a 12th-dimensional collective.
caveats: Daily-message repetition does not independently corroborate the source.
Practitioner descriptions of healing, DNA or energetic activation are not clinical verification.
2010 dates the general practice, not each named entity.

profiles.name: Adronis / Brad Johnson
profiles.origin: Adronis is presented as a Sirius A consciousness whose claimed density changes over time.
profiles.dateBasis: A 2016 interview biography gives December 2008 automatic writing, then 2009 vocal work.
profiles.summary: Johnson's channeling archive, now also presented through The Prime Mentor, includes Adronis material and intuitive-healing services.
claims: Reports Adronis contact through automatic writing before speech.
caveats: The 'density' classifications vary over time within the account.
Interview claims about illness or conspiracies are not independently established.
Current Prime Mentor site was unreadable as body text; channel description was indexed only.

profiles.name: Ishuwa of the Yahyel / Shaun Swanson
profiles.entity: Ishuwa; Yahyel; Sounds of Light; Group of Friends
profiles.classification: Claimed humanlike ET civilization and spiritual guides
profiles.origin: The Yahyel are presented as humanlike people in multiple locations beyond the solar system within the Milky Way.
profiles.datePrecision: Year; practice start, not Ishuwa-specific onset
profiles.dateBasis: Official biography dates Swanson's channeling/healing-facilitation work to 1995; the first Ishuwa encounter is not specified.
profiles.summary: A channeling practice emphasizing heart-based relationships and possible future open contact with the Yahyel.
claims: Presents Ishuwa as an interstellar explorer and heart-language translator.
Homepage attributes the Phoenix Lights to Yahyel pilots.
caveats: The Phoenix Lights attribution is an official-site claim, not an established explanation of that event.
Future peaceful contact is presented as a possibility.
1995 must not be labeled the first Yahyel session without additional evidence.

profiles.name: Kryon / Lee Carroll
profiles.origin: Carroll's official site calls Kryon an angelic source, rather than a biological ET species.
profiles.dateBasis: Official introduction explicitly states Lee began the work in 1989.
profiles.summary: A long-running channeling archive with free messages, books and commercial spiritual courses and products.
claims: Carroll presents himself as the original channel for Kryon.
The site describes Kryon messages as angelic spiritual information.
caveats: Other practitioners use the Kryon name; Carroll explicitly disclaims affiliation.
A name shared across channels does not establish that their sources are identical.
Healing programmes are not proof of medical efficacy.

profiles.name: Abraham / Esther Hicks
profiles.classification: Claimed nonphysical collective; not specifically ET
profiles.origin: Official material describes Abraham as group consciousness from a nonphysical dimension.
profiles.dateBasis: Esther's official Phoenix reflection gives 1985; workshops are separately dated to 1987 by her official biography.
profiles.summary: A major manifestation-teaching movement centered on Esther's presentations of Abraham and the Law of Attraction.
claims: Attributes teaching to Abraham, a nonphysical collective.
Presents thoughts and emotions as central to shaping experience.
caveats: This is not an ET-species lineage.
The official site says Jerry and Esther did not favor the term channeling.
Manifestation teaching should not be treated as proof that people cause illness or adversity through their thoughts.

profiles.name: The Guides / Paul Selig
profiles.classification: Claimed spiritual guides; mediumship and energy-healing practice
profiles.origin: Presented as higher spiritual intelligence rather than a named ET species.
profiles.datePrecision: Year; reported awakening, not securely first Guides session
profiles.dateBasis: Official biography dates a clairvoyant spiritual experience to 1987, then describes subsequent healing and intuitive work.
profiles.summary: An author of channeled books and workshop teacher who also describes a medium-for-the-living practice.
claims: Presents a series of books as transmissions from The Guides.
Describes intuitively stepping into the perspective of living people during readings.
caveats: 1987 should be labeled a reported awakening, not the first recorded Guides transmission.
Telepathic and healing descriptions are practitioner claims.
Academic credentials or teaching roles do not validate paranormal claims.

profiles.name: Sanaya / Suzanne Giesemann
profiles.entity: Sanaya; purported deceased loved ones and other spirit guides
profiles.classification: Claimed spirit collective and deceased-person mediumship
profiles.origin: Sanaya is described as a collective including former humans and beings without physical incarnations, not as one ET species.
profiles.dateBasis: Official history distinguishes poems beginning July 12, 2009 from Sanaya’s naming on August 1, 2010.
profiles.summary: A mediumship teacher whose public work combines purported contact with deceased people and channeled messages from Sanaya.
claims: Frames private readings as communication with deceased loved ones.
caveats: Precise dates are retrospective self-report.
Unexpected poetry does not establish an external source.
Practitioner claims of evidence are not independent confirmation of an afterlife.

findings: The source set covers 10 public practitioners and 18 primary or first-party sources. Most are self-descriptions, so they establish what is publicly claimed rather than the external reality of the guides.
Entity labels must remain practitioner-specific: Pleiadian, Arcturian, Sassani, Yahyel, Sirian, angelic and nonphysical collective are overlapping narrative categories, not a verified taxonomy.

Important chronology distinctions: Lyssa1985 versus Sasha1988; Esther1985 private experience versus workshops1987; Daniel2010 verbal practice versus daily website messages2012; Shaun1995 general practice rather than first Ishuwa session.
Wendy Kennedy has an explicit 1994/1995 conflict across official pages. Rob Gauthier has no securely established first-session date in this selected source set.
Suzanne Giesemann supplies precise retrospective dates for poems and Sanaya's naming; those should be labeled self-report and not confused with the start of all her mediumship.
Publicly offered private sessions are documented as services; no private session records, private client identities or closed-group content were accessed.
Healing claims, energetic codes, densities, light languages and claims of cellular effects are recorded as beliefs or marketing descriptions. This research did not establish treatment efficacy.
YouTube work here was catalogue/metadata research, not full playback or transcript analysis. Video dates are session dates only where explicitly provided; no upload-date claims were inferred.
